parsed.explanation: Parent regime imposes traveler-facing universal exposure: entry screening with document/sex discrepancy refusal, visa/fraud risks, national facility exclusion, and documented severe custody/immigration abuse. Courts only partially restrain these. The division’s nondiscrimination, public-accommodations, hate-crime, gender-neutral single-user bathrooms and care-shield laws materially reduce ordinary accommodation and healthcare risk, and protect travelling care-seekers. But under the rubric local protections cannot cancel national border, federal facilities or custody exposure. Enforcement data for some local remedies are absent, so silence is not safety; positive laws are credited but not assumed perfect. Consequences if outed are elevated, not near-automatic imprisonment/execution.
